name: r2c-ai-concierge-e2e
description: Playwright E2E tests for the R2C WordPress plugin (wp-env + a mocked R2C API — see tests-e2e/README.md). Dev-only, not part of the distributed plugin.

scripts.e2e:start: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate r2c-ai-concierge
scripts.e2e:ci: npm run e2e:start && npm run e2e
